name: To-do List
description: Keep a simple to-do list saved in your home folder.

changelog.1.1.0: Edit tasks, 'todo add/list/done/remove' from the shell, fixed the menu showing without its letters.
changelog.1.1.1: Now says what it can do (permissions: shown before you install, enforced while it runs), is listed in the new categories, and handles Ctrl+C and command-line arguments cleanly.
